CustomField.label: Comparison Display
CustomField.description: Controls how the Found/Expected comparison reveals per row. On demand = every resolved row (including a pass) shows a caret to reveal the values; failures still show their values inline. Failures only = a caret to reveal detail appears on failing rows only. Show on every row = the values are shown inline on every row without a caret. Source/query provenance behind the caret is a separate permission (Record Health Check View Details).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: On demand = caret on every row, including passes (values inline on failures). Failures only = caret on failing rows only. Show on every row = values inline everywhere.
